_comment: TEST ONLY placeholder questions so the pipeline can run before the real rubric is supplied. Not an authoritative assessment and not safety content. Replace with the real rubric (same shape).

text.hi: आप एक इलेक्ट्रीशियन के रूप में रोज़ किन औज़ारों का इस्तेमाल करते हैं? कम से कम तीन औज़ारों के नाम बताइए।
text.en: Which tools do you use every day as an electrician? Name at least three.

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. Looks for common hand tools being named.

criteria.description: Names a screwdriver or similar
Names pliers or a wire cutter
Names a tester

text.hi: काम में इस्तेमाल होने वाले किन्हीं दो अलग-अलग तरह के तारों के नाम और उनका सामान्य उपयोग बताइए।
text.en: Name any two different kinds of wire used in your work and one general use of each.

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. Two wire types and one general use.

criteria.description: Names at least two kinds of wire
Explains a general use of one wire
Answer is clear and relevant

text.hi: आपने इलेक्ट्रीशियन का काम कहां से सीखा? आईटीआई, अप्रेंटिसशिप, या किसी सीनियर के साथ? संक्षेप में बताइए।
text.en: Where did you learn electrician work: ITI, apprenticeship, or with a senior? Briefly explain.

criteria.description: Names a clear way of learning
Gives time or context

text.hi: घर में बिजली का मीटर क्या काम करता है, अपने शब्दों में समझाइए।
text.en: In your own words, what does the electricity meter at home do?

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. Meter measures consumption; used for billing.

criteria.description: Says the meter measures electricity consumption
Mentions its role in billing

text.hi: एसी और डीसी करंट में क्या अंतर है, अपने शब्दों में बताइए।
text.en: In your own words, what is the difference between AC and DC current?

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. AC alternates; DC flows one way; one example each.

criteria.description: Says AC changes direction and DC flows one way
Gives an example of each

text.hi: वोल्ट, एम्पीयर और वाट किसे नापते हैं? तीनों को अपने शब्दों में बताइए।
text.en: What do volt, ampere and watt measure? Explain each in your own words.

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. UNVALIDATED DRAFT, needs expert review. Voltage = electrical pressure, ampere = current flow, watt = power.

criteria.description: Explains volt as voltage / electrical pressure
Explains ampere as current / flow
Explains watt as power / consumption

text.hi: मल्टीमीटर से आप क्या-क्या नाप सकते हैं? कम से कम दो चीज़ें बताइए और यह भी कि इसे कब इस्तेमाल करते हैं।
text.en: What can you measure with a multimeter? Name at least two things and say when you would use it.

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. UNVALIDATED DRAFT, needs expert review. Voltage, current, resistance, continuity; used to find faults.

criteria.description: Names voltage
Names current, resistance or continuity
Says it is used to find a fault or problem

text.hi: एक ग्राहक कहता है कि उसकी छत का पंखा नहीं चल रहा। समस्या ढूंढने के लिए आप कौन-कौन से कदम किस क्रम में उठाएंगे?
text.en: A customer says the ceiling fan is not running. What steps would you take, and in what order, to find the problem?

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. UNVALIDATED DRAFT, needs expert review. General troubleshooting approach: symptoms, supply/switch/regulator, instrument or part replacement.

criteria.description: Starts by asking about or observing the symptoms
Looks at the switch, regulator or supply
Narrows down with an instrument or replaces the faulty part

text.hi: किसी नए कमरे की वायरिंग शुरू करने से पहले आप यह कैसे तय करेंगे कि कितना तार चाहिए?
text.en: Before you start wiring a new room, how would you work out how much wire you need?

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. UNVALIDATED DRAFT, needs expert review. Measure route, count points/loads, add margin.

criteria.description: Measures the room or the wire route
Counts the points and fittings
Adds extra for bends, joints or waste

text.hi: ग्राहक शिकायत करता है कि आपका किया हुआ काम एक हफ़्ते बाद ही ठीक से नहीं चल रहा। आप क्या करेंगे?
text.en: A customer complains that the work you did stopped working properly a week later. What do you do?

questions.ideal_notes: TEST ONLY. UNVALIDATED DRAFT, needs expert review. Listen, find the cause, fix, take responsibility.

criteria.description: Listens or asks what happened and goes to see it
Finds the cause and fixes it
Takes responsibility and explains to the customer
